verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a CLI that gives "AI agents and scripts full access" to workspaces, covering the Journeys and Pipelines APIs through a single `cio api` command. Every command returns structured JSON and is self-describing via `cio schema`, and a published OpenAPI spec plus Track/App APIs support scripted, UI-free automation. missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline or non-interactive authentication guidance (e.g., env-var tokens, CI examples), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
